entities.summary: Oksen Vasyliovych Lisovyi is a Ukrainian teacher, educational organiser and soldier of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. He has served as Minister of Education and Science since 21 March 2023 and Director of the National Center "Minor Academy of Sciences of Ukraine" since 10 June 2010.
